content:
{'text': '資深共和黨策略師卡爾·羅夫對總統唐納德·特朗普早前向他以及參議員約翰·科寧（共和黨，德州）發出的猛烈抨擊不以為然，特朗普將德州總檢察長肯恩·帕克斯頓競逐參議院席位前景下滑歸咎於二人。', 'paragraph_context': 'Longtime Republican strategist Karl Rove shrugged off President Donald Trump’s tirade at him and Sen. John Cornyn (R-Texas) earlier this week that blamed them for Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton’s declining prospects in his bid for a Senate seat.'}

{'text': '獲特朗普背書的共和黨候選人帕克斯頓，在11月期中選舉前面臨重大挑戰，此前已爆發多宗爭議，最新一宗是最近洩漏的錄音，當中他將特朗普不受歡迎的伊朗戰爭歸咎為其選戰在傳統紅州落後的原因。《紐約時報》報道，帕克斯頓的民主黨對手詹姆斯·塔拉里科目前在民調中領先。', 'paragraph_context': 'Paxton, the Trump-endorsed GOP candidate, faces major challenges ahead of the November midterm election after a slew of reported controversies, the latest of which is recently leaked audio of him blaming Trump’s unpopular war in Iran as the reason why his campaign is lagging in a traditionally red state. The New York Times reports that Paxton’s Democratic opponent, James Talarico, is leading the polls.'}

{'text': '特朗普在向羅夫和科寧開火時，並沒有將上述任何因素，或其自身政府的困境納入考慮。', 'paragraph_context': 'Trump didn’t factor in any of that, or the struggles of his own administration, when he went after Rove and Cornyn.'}

{'text': '特朗普周四在Truth Social上怒罵：「令人遺憾，而且非常愚蠢的是，約翰·科寧，加上他的小夥伴、超級RINO卡爾·羅夫，正竭盡所能讓肯恩·帕克斯頓——德州史上最強、也是全美最強的總檢察長之一——難以在即將到來的期中選舉中擊敗極左狂人詹姆斯·塔拉怪胎，此人是德州價值的對立面。」', 'paragraph_context': '“Sadly, and very stupidly, John Cornyn, and his Liddle’ Buddy, Super RINO, Karl Rove, are doing everything possible to make it hard for Ken Paxton, the Greatest Attorney General in the History of Texas, and one of the Best in the United States, to win the upcoming Midterm Election against a Radical Left Lunatic, James TalaFREAKO, who is the ANTITHESIS of Texas Values,” Trump raged on Truth Social Thursday.'}

{'text': '羅夫周四在霍士新聞「Guy Benson Show」節目播出時反擊特朗普，指這「聽起來像他認為帕克斯頓會輸，所以正在找人揹鑊」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Rove fired back at Trump on Thursday’s airing of Fox News’ “The Guy Benson Show,” stating that it “sounds like he thinks Paxton is going to lose, and he’s looking for somebody to blame.”'}

{'text': '他補充道：「如果我又軟弱又無能，我怎可能削弱一位贏得德州96%郡縣的人的力量？」', 'paragraph_context': '“And if I’m weak and ineffective, how could I have done anything to diminish the power of the man who won 96% of Texas counties?” he added.'}

{'text': '他告訴Benson：「我不知道總統在說什麼，恕我直言，我真的不在乎。」', 'paragraph_context': 'He told Benson, “I don’t know what the president’s talking about, and with all due respect, I really don’t care.”'}
